about_the_game:
🪐 Destroy All Letters: Space Adventure

Get ready to embark on an intergalactic journey where your reflexes and typing precision will decide the fate of your rocket! Destroy All Letters: Space Adventure is an arcade typing game that blends action, challenge, and skill in an electrifying rhythm.

Master your rocket by using your keyboard — every key you press makes the ship rise, while silence makes it fall. Your mission is simple yet intense: dodge dangerous numbers, stay afloat, and conquer space!

Each correct input gives you thrust and points; every mistake can be costly. Test your focus, speed, and coordination in an experience that challenges even the most agile players.

🚀 Main Features

  • Unique typing gameplay – Rise, dodge, and survive by typing with precision and rhythm.

  • Two game modes – Face the endless mode for infinite challenge, or try the limited mode with defined objectives.

  • Performance system – Track your time, hits, and mistakes in real time.

  • Leaderboard – Compare your score and prove you’re the best pilot-typist in the universe.

Climb as high as you can, push your limits, and discover how far your typing skills can take you into space!
